integrity_notes: The proof is analytic and self-contained from the published width-function definition.
No independent audit or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The two-level formula does not directly evaluate channels with three or more distinct transition-probability levels.
The exact maximum-gap result is proved only for crossover probability \(\epsilon\le(q-1)/q\).
The coding-rate interval in the cited literature has a bounded-likelihood-ratio hypothesis; the functional-information formula itself does not.
title: Exact functional information for q-ary symmetric channels
